correctness.rationale: The factorization is an exact polynomial identity in F_3[X,Y,Z]. Every pair intersection is checked, tangencies are order exactly two by smooth conic/line Bezout, local normalization quotients give node delta 1 and tacnode delta 2, and normalization-unit exact sequence gives the split Picard group. All finite-field counts follow from five rational components with ten rational pairwise intersection points; executable independent exact field enumeration verifies q=3,9,27.

value.rationale: The special fiber at an exceptional prime in a classical genus-six arithmetic family is a natural precise object. Its complete non-semistable local types, K5 weighted component graph, split six-torus/four-vector generalized Picard variety and exact all-extension zeta distinguish arithmetic and singularity structure that qualitative reducibility omits. It is not merely a renaming or arbitrary parameter slice; the prime 3 is the natural excluded characteristic.
